name: Live
overview: Scripture reveals that life originates from God’s breath, making man a living soul as shown in Genesis 2:7. Eternal life is offered through faith in Jesus Christ, who came to provide abundant life beyond mere existence (John 3:16; John 10:10). Jesus further declares Himself as the source and way to true life, emphasizing that living rightly involves following Him (John 14:6). This teaching encompasses how we should live our lives, striving for purity and alignment with God’s will.
